summary: Iteration 116 — Keeper's Circle gold marker on unlocked LoreCards. Code review + guest-state DOM verification. Files changed: only frontend/src/components/LoreCard.jsx and frontend/src/components/ArchiveLedger.jsx (git diff confirmed; backend/.env change is unrelated env config, not part of this feature). Verified: (a) ArchiveLedger.jsx line 141 computes const isKeeper = rank === 'keepers_circle' from rankData?.rank; passed to all 4 <TierGroup> (Tier I/II/III/Special) which forwards to <LoreCard isKeeper=...>. (b) LoreCard.jsx line 71 gates showKeeperMarker = isKeeper && unlocked — locked cards CANNOT render the pip regardless of rank. (c) When true, article receives inset+outer gold box-shadow (rgba(245,211,0,...)) and renders <span data-testid=`lore-card-keeper-pip-${entry.slug}`> with radial-gradient gold fill + border + animation keeper-pip-pulse 2.8s ease-in-out infinite. (d) @keyframes keeper-pip-pulse scoped to card (rendered inside the same conditional block, line 297-304) — only present when showKeeperMarker is true. DOM verification on live /archive (guest, no wallet): 62 lore cards render, 0 keeper pips present (negative case ✓), tier counts 0/16, 0/25, 0/20 present, Ledger/Daily Drops/The Record all switch, LoreCardModal opens on card click, rank_title shows 'Unranked'. Positive-case DOM (KC-rank wallet with 61 unlocks) could not be simulated from the preview browser since the wallet is supplied via Solana wallet-adapter context (Phantom SIWS) — not from localStorage or URL. Attempted route interception forced entries but rank fetch only fires when the ArchiveLedger `wallet` prop is truthy, which requires an actual wallet-adapter connection. This limitation is explicitly acknowledged in the review request. Code-path correctness is exhaustively confirmed via file inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: Correctness: showKeeperMarker gate (isKeeper && unlocked) is the right invariant — locked cards can never show the pip. Verified in DOM (0 pips on guest /archive).

Encapsulation: the <style> block containing @keyframes keeper-pip-pulse is rendered inside every showKeeperMarker card. If a user has 40+ unlocked cards at KC, 40+ identical <style> tags will be injected into the DOM. Not a bug (browser dedupes CSS by rule text), but consider hoisting the keyframe to a single global stylesheet or the top of ArchiveLedger.jsx once, gated by isKeeper.
Prop plumbing: TierGroup passes isKeeper unconditionally; if a future refactor short-circuits TierGroup when entries.length===0 (already the case at line 42), no wasted work — clean.
Accessibility: aria-label='Keeper's Circle marker' on the pip is good; the article's aria-label ('Open <name>') is unchanged so screen readers still announce the primary CTA.

success_rate.backend: N/A (no backend changes; unchanged in this feature)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the verifiable surface (guest negative case + code inspection). Positive live-DOM case not reachable without a KC-ranked Phantom wallet — flagged as expected in the request.

test_credentials: Preview app is publicly accessible; no gate encountered on /archive in this run.
seed_data_creation: None. Attempted route-intercept mock of /api/archive/rank was inert because the ArchiveLedger only fetches rank when its wallet prop is truthy. No DB writes made; no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To positively verify the keeper pip renders end-to-end, you need a Phantom wallet connected via SIWS with rank='keepers_circle' seeded in the archive_ranks collection AND 61 rows in archive_unlocks for that wallet. Route-intercept of /api/archive/rank alone will NOT work — ArchiveLedger gates the rank fetch on wallet truthy (line 92). Fastest positive path: use Playwright's addInitScript to shim window.solana or the wallet-adapter's connected/publicKey state; alternatively add a temporary ?wallet=<addr> URL param wired into the parent Archive page during future refactors.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Implementation matches spec exactly. Prop plumbing (ArchiveLedger → TierGroup → LoreCard) is clean; showKeeperMarker correctly enforces unlocked-only visibility; keyframe is scoped; data-testid follows the requested pattern lore-card-keeper-pip-{slug}; only the two intended files were modified.
